question: Should this PR be narrowed back to the SMS clarification before review continues, or should maintainers intentionally review it as a broad catch-up branch?
rationale: The current head mixes the intended SMS fix with already-main and security/compatibility-sensitive work, so maintainer intent is needed before anyone treats this exact head as mergeable.

options.title: Narrow and rebase
options.body: Rebase onto current main and keep only the SMS copy, docs, rejection diagnostic, and focused test changes in this PR.

options.title: Split broad work
options.body: Move unrelated workspace, custom-header, QA, session, extension, and UI changes into their existing or separate PRs before reviewing the SMS fix.

options.title: Review as broad branch
options.body: Accept the larger review burden and require owner review/proof for every unrelated compatibility and security-sensitive surface before merge.

recommendation.title: Narrow and rebase
recommendation.body: Rebase onto current main and keep only the SMS copy, docs, rejection diagnostic, and focused test changes in this PR.

likelyOwner.reason: obviyus is the requested reviewer and is tied by merged history to the Android SMS policy boundary this PR is meant to clarify.
